findings.F1: The tested idea's giveback lives on the first day and fades by the plan's 3-day horizon: in folds B and C, the 396 cases (on 177 days) have a short-signed unusual move of +1.26 % over 1 day (day-clustered t 2.56), but only +0.53 % over 2 days (t 0.70), +0.75 % over 3 days (t 0.97) and +0.73 % over 5 days (t 0.85). This matches step 5's 3-bar result of +0.43 % with t 1.01.
findings.F2: Over 1 day, the giveback is large enough to trade even with the coin's drift left in: the total short move is +1.08 % per case (t 2.20), about 4.9 times the 0.22 % cost of a trade. Over 3 days the total move is +0.27 % (t 0.35), below that cost.
findings.F3: The one-day reversal is broad across the falling-agitated days themselves: the 590 up days are followed by a short-signed unusual move of +0.98 % the next day, and the 614 other days by −1.10 % (Welch t 6.38). It is positive for 8 of the 10 coins seen, with ZEC +1.50 % (t 2.02), BTC +1.03 % (t 2.19) and ADA +2.49 % (t 3.55), and positive in all four years of folds B and C (+0.66 % to +1.66 %).
findings.F4: The grading the idea claims is not visible here. Over 1 day, the forecast quartiles give +1.76 %, +1.36 %, +1.23 % and +0.70 %, smallest for the largest forecasts. The top scaled-rise quintile (mean 1.53 usual moves) gives only +0.28 %, against +0.82 % to +1.82 % for the others. The slope on the scaled rise is −0.0024 (t −0.60, 590 up days) over 1 day and +0.0009 (t 0.10) over 3 days. So the 1-day test may still fail the slope check.
findings.F5: Over 3 days the effect varies a lot between periods: the w16 cases give −0.79 % (87 cases, 29 days) and the 2020 cases −0.78 % (t −0.49), against +2.02 % in 2018. This later-day noise is what drowns the first day's giveback at the plan's horizon.

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, a coin's one-day rise that is larger against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days is followed by a larger fall over the next 1 day.
ideas.consequence: A trader in an agitated decline should expect the bounce day to be partly given back by the next day's close, not over the following days, and should not carry the short beyond a day.
ideas.name: agitated-decline rally fades next day
